events.text: {"verdict":"needs_adi","decision":"Do not attempt captures again until preflight prints READY from the runner itself; the last two runs proved the lock screen and the missing Accessibility grant stop everything. Keep T-132 blocked on T-351 and keep the ask on T-351 only (set T-351 to blocked, doing Adi, with the ask below), removing the duplicate from T-132. Meanwhile, make preflight print sys.executable and the runner's parent process, so the ask names the exact binary macOS checks. At the start of every runner pass, run preflight. The moment it prints READY, start `caffeinate -dimsu` for the length of the run so the screen cannot lock again, then run the spec in one pass: prep, create the routine, capture the 5 slots, redact, fill shots[], delete the routine, log it in REVERT_LEDGER.md, confirm check-guides drops by 5, commit, push, and set review for Amal.","why":"T-132 log 2026-10-10 20:52 and 20:54: Mac locked since 20:22 IST and AXIsProcessTrusted false for the runner. T-351's 2026-10-09 12:02 check passed, but evidently not for the runner's process. Unlocking and granting Accessibility are physical steps at the Mac.","outward_ok":["Create a temporary weekly local routine in the Claude desktop app for the screenshots, then delete it and log it in scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md","Launch and drive the Claude desktop app with open -a, claude:// links and System Events once preflight prints READY","Commit the redacted captures and filled shots[] to main and push"],"reassign_to_claude":false,"adi_input":{"ask":"At the Mac: 1) unlock it and leave it unlocked with the Claude app open. 2) Open x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_Accessibility (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility), click +, press Cmd+Shift+G, add /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/Resources/Python.app and switch it on. Check: python3 app/scripts/shots/claude-app-shots.py preflight prints READY.","kind":"physical","why_only_adi":"macOS lets only the person at the Mac type the login password and switch on an Accessibility grant."}}
